title: Sun & Moon Battle — Gauntlet vs Bulbagarden SM captures

rounds.gap: Fan panel is a flat, un-outlined, single-light WebGL render: no cel shading, no inverted-hull outlines, flat star-quad palms, hard-edged sea/horizon band, and a near-uniform glow instead of layered fire with internal structure.
rounds.note: Blind critic called the official Inferno Overdrive frame authentic (high confidence) and picked our Z-Move panel as the fake. Also flagged that the HK plate stays visible during the cinematic.

Blind critic (high confidence) called OUR command screen the authentic 3DS capture and the official Battle-Royal bottom screen the mockup - it read the bar's mini arena map + trainer icons as 'black-outlined pixel sprites on a flat 2D field', which is a misreading of the reference, so treat the win as provisional; the genuinely useful signal is that it found no web-mockup tells in our plates, Z-POWER chip or cream container.

rounds.gap: Capture was letterboxed to 1.36:1 by a layout overflow, so the foe plate was cut off at the frame edge (name floating, HP bar with no end cap or ball badge); plus: no cel/rim outline on the models, flat gradient sky/sea with a hard horizon, untextured cylinder palms, plain dot instead of a gender glyph, ALL-CAPS 'FIRIUM Z', invented 'Exeggutor A' form suffix, and the opponent's head off-frame with stray frond geometry at the right edge.
rounds.note: Blind critic picked the official Ember_VII capture (medium confidence). Its two biggest tells were the non-5:3 aspect (my top-only CSS overflow bug, since fixed) and the missing outline pass (since added: toon ramp + inverted-hull outlines). UI vocabulary fixes (gender glyph, title-case item name, no form suffix) are queued for the HUD builder.

Blind critic (medium confidence) called OUR move menu the authentic capture and praised it specifically: bevel-edged white plates with type-coloured left bars, amber Z-MOVE plate with the corner Z medallion, white-with-pink-outline cursor, softness reading like a native 320x240 capture. Caveat: it again misread the reference (a Battle-Royal bottom screen: mini-map, trainer icons, '+' markers, weather chip) as a fake 2D field, so the win is provisional.

rounds.gap: Litten is off-model (glowing flame tail instead of a fur tuft, white muzzle/chest where the species has red-orange face fur, solid orange crown patch instead of thin red forehead stripes); the foe reads as a 45x17 px white blob; the sand is one flat cream plane with no visible texture (luminance sigma ~1); no Gen VII background defocus; palm trunks are smooth cylinders with painted rings instead of bark.
rounds.note: Blind critic picked the official Freeze_VII capture (medium confidence). Two engineering-level gaps: no depth-of-field and no visible ground texture. The tail-tuft canon point is correct and is being fixed with official-artwork references added to bar/.
